## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes
* fix: Probe substream during camera startup to show correct resolution by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/66
* fix: Persist settings tab across component remounts during updates by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/67
* fix: Increase icon size inside IconButton for better visibility by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/69
### Other Changes
* refactor: Convert action buttons to icons and add camera status feedback by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/68


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/compare/v0.35.0-beta...v0.35.1-beta
